decisions.reason: As a niche men's care series that showed no continued prominence after launch, it likely performed below aspiration relative to the firm's core skincare products, and a narrow portfolio suggests limited slack for carrying a weaker extension.

As a facial cleansing foam closely tied to the existing Sandorini line, it fits the firm's core capabilities and customer expectations well, so even with limited later launch signaling it likely remains satisfactory enough to retain.
